smarttube.hash_provenance: Official F-Droid index-v1.json served over HTTPS; package entry versionCode 2446
smarttube.notes: Independent F-Droid build; not the upstream stable/beta signing key. Updates are manual. No guarantee of uninterrupted YouTube access without sign-in.

airplay.notes: AirPlay mirroring receiver; not an Apple-certified DRM receiver; client phone verification required.

projectivy.notes: Optional alternative. RU/ES/EN interface checked on the owner TV; custom wallpaper and themes opened Premium. No purchase or bypass.

browser.notes: Required WebView-based browser; included in default install.

plume.notes: Optional fallback retained on the owner TV. Light/dark and own wallpaper checked; English-only settings. Daily GitHub update checks and optional IP-based weather. No accessibility, secure-settings or TV-listing grant.

couchy.hash_provenance: Official GitHub release asset SHA-256 digest; downloaded APK bytes independently matched it
couchy.notes: Selected default HOME on the owner TV. Static custom JPEG, six-app Dock, clock/date, native JSON import/export and RU/ES/EN UI checked. English is absent from the explicit v1.0.6 picker; use English system/app locale or imported language=en. Switching back to system language can require relaunch; see verification.json. No light/dark switch or speedup established. INTERNET and REQUEST_DELETE_PACKAGES declared; no privileged grants or uninstalls.

files.hash_provenance: Official GitHub release asset digest, matched against independently downloaded APK
files.notes: Explicit owner-approved optional document picker for Couchy; TV firmware resolves OPEN_DOCUMENT to a stub. Excluded from default five-app setup. All-files access needs explicit files-access on and is journaled; APK requests remain denied. APK declares INTERNET/foreground-service/Shizuku permissions; no root/Shizuku/notification permissions granted by the toolkit. Installed and native JPEG/JSON picker checked on this TV; owner explicitly authorized shared TV/attached-storage access. No laptop shares configured.

launcher_release_review.scope: Three launcher GitHub latest-release redirects only; other third-party apps not checked for newest upstream versions
